Odisha Priest Held for Temple Assault on Minor

In a recent court ruling, an Odisha priest was sentenced to imprisonment for allegedly stripping and assaulting a minor boy at a temple. The incident occurred in a temple in Odisha, where the priest worked as a tutor. The court's decision has raised concerns about child safety and protection within religious institutions.
